_meta.usage: a whole CEP (22041-001, 22041001) or its first three digits (220); for a pre-1992 five-digit CEP pass its first three digits. Other lengths, five-digit values included (they look like US, German or French postcodes), don't fit this table and are not looked up
_meta.note: CEP first digits → UF (Correios ranges). The first digit is one of ten postal regions counted anticlockwise from São Paulo (0–1 SP, 2 RJ/ES, 3 MG, 4 BA/SE, 5 PE/AL/PB/RN, 6 CE/PI/MA/PA/AP/AM/RR/AC, 7 DF/GO/TO/MT/RO/MS, 8 PR/SC, 9 RS). Split ranges: Distrito Federal 70000–72799 and 73000–73699; Goiás 72800–72999 (towns around the DF) and 73700–76799 (the rest of the state, Goiânia included); Amazonas around Roraima's 69300–69399. Rows inside a state capital's range say so where the range falls on whole 3-digit keys (single table). In August 2008 Rondônia moved from 78900–78999 to 76800–76999 (until then the end of Goiás's block), so old signs and documents can carry 789xx for Rondônia; 789 is kept with that note. Rows 100–109 are unverified: one published table puts them in São Paulo, the other skips them; the Correios' own range search sits behind a CAPTCHA and its API needs a contract. A CEP on a sign is the address of that shop or office, so it is strong evidence for the photo's place; a CEP on a delivery van or packaging is not.
source: https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Código_de_Endereçamento_Postal (table 'Zonas Postais e Faixas de CEP', capital ranges, and history of Rondônia's 2008 change, revision 72831864, citing Correios)
https://www.ruacep.com.br/guias/postais/faixa-de-cep-por-estado/ (UF ranges, stated to follow Correios data)
https://www.correios.com.br/atendimento/developers/manuais/manual-api-busca-cep (Correios API manual; its example gives Acre 69900000–69999999)

https://overpass-api.de (OpenStreetMap postal_code tags of the 2,469 Brazilian municipality relations that have one, boundary=administrative admin_level=8, queried 2026-11-12; all fall inside their UF's range here)
